## Coriander Cumin

Coriander Cumin is the gruff, mustachioed unicorn who hosts **The Tasty Treat**, a struggling Indian-inspired restaurant in Canterlot, with his daughter and chef **Saffron Masala**. In *Friendship Is Magic*, Pinkie Pie and Rarity help the two rediscover why they loved cooking together. Recognize him by his amber-gold coat, curled dark-raspberry mane, thick mustache, magenta eyes, and brown high-collared jacket.

**Name and voice.** “Coriander Cumin” is an on-screen, spoken name: he introduces himself when Pinkie asks; it also appears in the episode's cast credits. Both words name spices, matching Saffron's culinary name. He speaks extensively, voiced in English by **Lee Tockar**; Saffron is voiced by Diana Kaarina. No verified disguise or alternate persona. See the [episode dialogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Spice_Up_Your_Life) and [season-six voice credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six).

**Appearance and continuity.** His principal confirmed appearance is *“Spice Up Your Life”* (season 6, episode 12; June 11, 2016) in the G4 television continuity. Some listings use episode 13 (the production-order number). See the [episode production listing](https://www.intanibase.com/iad_entries/entry?shortID=37496) and the [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAAfddIfbRk).

## Important moments

All scenes are in *“Spice Up Your Life”* (S6E12); scene timestamps in the official full episode could not be verified.

- **Closing before dinner is over.** Coriander stacks chairs while guests are still present, exposing how fear of failure has strained his relationship with Saffron. *(Timestamp unavailable.)*
- **Choosing a critic's approval.** He reluctantly goes along with Rarity's bland, fashionable makeover, placing the restaurant's identity—and Saffron's ambitions—at risk. *(Timestamp unavailable.)*
- **Remembering their homemade soup.** Saffron serves his spicy flat-noodle soup, bringing back memories of cooking together and helping father and daughter reconcile. *(Timestamp unavailable.)*
- **Welcoming the crowd on their own terms.** He thanks Pinkie and Rarity, joins Saffron in reopening with flavorful food, and proudly welcomes customers despite Zesty Gourmand's disapproval. *(Timestamp unavailable.)*
